interval_caveat: Wilson intervals assume independent trials; these trades share sessions. They describe sample size, not a validated future hit-rate guarantee.

new_models.semantics: Direction times max(0, 2*p(TP)-1), with the higher estimated side chosen. This is an uncalibrated TP confidence estimate, not the earlier speed utility.
